text: DSH Infra Observability 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的运行观测插件。它通过 bundle patch 接入宿主，并在主机端监听工具结果、agent 错误和状态事件，形成工具与技能用量记录、错误统计及会话投影。用户可查看最近执行记录和使用汇总、审计已挂载技能目录，并查询运行状态；浏览器会话视图提供观测标签页，展示回合、工具与技能统计及近期执行。适合需要了解 DSH 工具调用、技能使用和运行状况的用户。代码未声明外部 API 密钥。

DSH Infra Observability records real tool and skill usage, agent errors, and runtime state. Its usage_report summarizes activity and recent calls; audit_skills checks the mounted skill catalog; infra_health reports runtime status. A web conversation tab displays session counts and recent executions.
想查看 DSH 最近调用了哪些工具以及成功或失败情况。
如何统计不同技能在 DSH 中的使用次数？
DSH 有没有能审计已挂载技能目录并查看运行状态的工具？
DSH Infra Observability 的功能「工具与技能用量报告」：主机端按真实工具结果记录调用、成功或失败，并按日期累计工具和技能次数；调用 usage_report 可查看指定天数的汇总与最近十次执行记录。
DSH Infra Observability 的功能「观测会话面板」：浏览器会话视图注册“觀測”标签，呈现回合数、工具与技能调用统计、失败数和近期执行；若文件活动或机制事件投影存在，也会追加对应区块。
@bryan-cmf/dsh-infra-observability 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 87 天；提交数 5；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) host plugin
that replaces model self-reporting with **structural recording**:

@bryan-cmf/dsh-infra-observability README · 🔭 Infra Observability — DSH-Plugin：- **`tools/result` listener** — every real tool execution (name + outcome) is
  recorded by the platform into a ring buffer and per-day aggregates.
- **`agent/error` / `agent/status`** — error totals and live-agent tracking.
- **Watchdog** — timer-driven alert when agent errors spike (≥ N in 5 min).
- **Three tools** for the model and humans:

@bryan-cmf/dsh-infra-observability README · 🔭 Infra Observability — DSH-Plugin：| Tool | What it reports |
| --- | --- |
| `usage_report` | Per-day tool/skill aggregates (calls / ok / err) + recent executions |
| `audit_skills` | Catalog totals, provider spread, warnings (missing description, non-kebab names), today's skill usage |
| `infra_health` | Uptime, records kept, error counts, running agents, catalog size, watchdog state |

@bryan-cmf/dsh-infra-observability README · Dashboard (browser)：The client half registers an **「觀測」view tab** (order 20, right of
chat / trajectory) rendering a live per-session dashboard from the `infraView`
session projection: turn counts, failure count, tool/skill TOP lists with
success-rate bars, and the recent execution trail. Data updates as events
commit — no refresh needed.

@bryan-cmf/dsh-infra-observability README · Path B — Agent preset row：```yaml
- id: infra-observability
  name: '@bryan-cmf/dsh-infra-observability'
```

@bryan-cmf/dsh-infra-observability README · Requirements：- DSH `>= 0.1.0-rc.6` (services: `tools`, `timer`, `skills` — all part of the
  shipped `dsh-base` bundle)

@bryan-cmf/dsh-infra-observability README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxRecords` | `5000` | Ring-buffer cap for recent execution records |
| `healthIntervalMs` | `60000` | Watchdog check interval |
| `errorAlertThreshold` | `5` | Alert at ≥ this many agent errors per 5-minute window |

@bryan-cmf/dsh-infra-observability README · Scope notes：- Aggregates are process-lifetime (like `dsh-skill-trail`); the durable source
  of truth remains the session log. Cross-restart persistence is planned.
- Companion package: [`@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail`](https://github.com/Bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail)
  renders the per-reply badge row; this package is the backend layer.
